Zhight Island (Quest)#001.src: Hello, esteemed tourist sir or madame! I see you have found my illustrious resort, {p}!
Zhight Island (Quest)#001.dst: Merhaba, saygıdeğer turist beyefendi ya da hanımefendi! Görüyorum ki muhteşem tatil köyümü buldunuz, {p}!
Zhight Island (Quest)#001.speaker: Zhight

Zhight Island (Quest)#002.src: Normally, you'd need a reservation to stay here, but our human visitors are ALWAYS welcome! Ehm...
Zhight Island (Quest)#002.dst: Normalde burada kalmak için rezervasyon gerekir, ama insan misafirlerimize kapımız HER ZAMAN açık! Ehm...
Zhight Island (Quest)#002.speaker: Zhight

Zhight Island (Quest)#003.src: ...w-well, actually...wait, no, it's nothing, nothing, friend! I guarantee you'll enjoy your stay here!
Zhight Island (Quest)#003.dst: ...a-aslında... dur, yok, bir şey yok, bir şey yok, dostum! Burada kalmaktan keyif alacağını garanti ederim!
Zhight Island (Quest)#003.speaker: Zhight

Zhight Island (Quest)#004.src: Even if m-my usual supplies haven't arrived in weeks, I, um, I'm TOTALLY sure we can accommodate for you!
Zhight Island (Quest)#004.dst: H-her zamanki malzemelerim haftalardır gelmemiş olsa bile, şey, seni ağırlayabileceğimizden KESİNLİKLE eminim!
Zhight Island (Quest)#004.speaker: Zhight

Zhight Island (Quest)#005.src: We can just...um...w-well, I won't impose on you, dearest most welcomest traveller, no sir! Or madame!
Zhight Island (Quest)#005.dst: Biz sadece... şey... y-yani, seni rahatsız etmeyeceğim, en kıymetli, en hoş gelmiş yolcum, hayır efendim! Ya da hanımefendi!
Zhight Island (Quest)#005.speaker: Zhight

Zhight Island (Quest)#006.src: B-But, if, perchance, you were to, um...happen to find my supplier, Phief, who hasn't come around in weeks the bas-
Zhight Island (Quest)#006.dst: A-ama, eğer bir ihtimal, şey... haftalardır ortalarda görünmeyen tedarikçim Phief'e denk gelirsen, o al-
Zhight Island (Quest)#006.speaker: Zhight

Zhight Island (Quest)#007.src: I! I mean! Nothing, nothing! Just, ehm, our extra reliable supplier often stops by {p} for supplies...
Zhight Island (Quest)#007.dst: Ben! Yani! Bir şey yok, bir şey yok! Sadece, ehm, son derece güvenilir tedarikçimiz malzeme için sık sık {p} şehrine uğrar...
Zhight Island (Quest)#007.speaker: Zhight

Zhight Island (Quest)#008.src: S-So, if you just happen to stop by there after your lovely stay here, and tell him to get off his sorry butt and send me my supplies that'd be just peachy!
Zhight Island (Quest)#008.dst: Y-yani, buradaki güzel konaklamandan sonra bir şekilde oraya uğrarsan ve ona o tembel kıçını kaldırıp malzemelerimi göndermesini söylersen, harika olur!
Zhight Island (Quest)#008.speaker: Zhight

Zhight Island (Quest)#010.src: Hello there. I see Zhight has sent you, correct?
Zhight Island (Quest)#010.dst: Merhaba. Seni Zhight gönderdi, değil mi?
Zhight Island (Quest)#010.speaker: Phief

Zhight Island (Quest)#011.src: I do hope he isn't mad at me. I fully intended to bring the supplies to him.
Zhight Island (Quest)#011.dst: Umarım bana kızgın değildir. Malzemeleri ona götürmeye kesinlikle niyetliydim.
Zhight Island (Quest)#011.speaker: Phief

Zhight Island (Quest)#012.src: But things took a turn for the worst quickly, and I no longer have access to my ship.
Zhight Island (Quest)#012.dst: Ama işler hızla kötüye gitti ve artık gemime ulaşamıyorum.
Zhight Island (Quest)#012.speaker: Phief

Zhight Island (Quest)#013.src: A madman jumped onto my ship, overpowered me, and held me hostage!
Zhight Island (Quest)#013.dst: Deli bir adam gemime atladı, beni alt etti ve rehin tuttu!
Zhight Island (Quest)#013.speaker: Phief

Zhight Island (Quest)#014.src: He was telling me how he wanted to "take back what was stolen from him", and it looked like he was heading to {p}.
Zhight Island (Quest)#014.dst: Bana "kendisinden çalınanı geri almak" istediğini anlatıyordu, {p} tarafına gidiyor gibiydi.
Zhight Island (Quest)#014.speaker: Phief

Zhight Island (Quest)#015.src: I have no clue whether he was deranged, paranoid, or if someone really did take something from him.
Zhight Island (Quest)#015.dst: Kafayı mı yemişti, paranoyak mıydı, yoksa biri gerçekten ondan bir şey mi almıştı, hiçbir fikrim yok.
Zhight Island (Quest)#015.speaker: Phief

Zhight Island (Quest)#016.src: I am certain of one thing. Nobody is going to sail my boat but me. I took my first chance to escape, broke the controls.
Zhight Island (Quest)#016.dst: Bir şeyden eminim. Benim teknemi benden başkası süremez. İlk fırsatta kaçtım, dümeni bozdum.
Zhight Island (Quest)#016.speaker: Phief

Zhight Island (Quest)#017.src: And I swam back to land, here. Problem is, I haven't exactly decided how I'll get the ship back for myself.
Zhight Island (Quest)#017.dst: Ve yüzerek karaya, buraya döndüm. Sorun şu ki gemiyi nasıl geri alacağıma pek karar veremedim.
Zhight Island (Quest)#017.speaker: Phief

Zhight Island (Quest)#018.src: Find Phief's ship, and return it to its rightful owner
Zhight Island (Quest)#018.dst: Phief'in gemisini bul ve gerçek sahibine geri ver

Zhight Island (Quest)#019.src: He told you what?! That fumbleknuckle...
Zhight Island (Quest)#019.dst: Sana ne dedi?! O beceriksiz ahmak...
Zhight Island (Quest)#019.speaker: Tirt

Zhight Island (Quest)#020.src: We didn't steal the ship from Phief, we were taking back what he stole from us years ago!
Zhight Island (Quest)#020.dst: Gemiyi Phief'ten çalmadık, yıllar önce bizden çaldığını geri alıyorduk!
Zhight Island (Quest)#020.speaker: Tirt

Zhight Island (Quest)#021.src: He attacked us on our way home to {p}, kicked us off the boat, and sailed it to who-knows-where.
Zhight Island (Quest)#021.dst: Eve, {p} tarafına dönerken bize saldırdı, bizi tekneden attı ve kim bilir nereye götürdü.
Zhight Island (Quest)#021.speaker: Tirt

Zhight Island (Quest)#022.src: We didn't think we would ever get it back, until we started seeing him sailing to that doofbumble Zhight.
Zhight Island (Quest)#022.dst: Onu o salak bozuntusu Zhight'a gemiyle giderken görmeye başlayana kadar asla geri alamayacağımızı düşünüyorduk.
Zhight Island (Quest)#022.speaker: Tirt

Zhight Island (Quest)#023.src: Luckily, he decided to claim an island so close to {p}, or else we would have never seen him.
Zhight Island (Quest)#023.dst: Neyse ki {p} bölgesine bu kadar yakın bir adayı sahiplenmeye karar verdi, yoksa onu asla görmezdik.
Zhight Island (Quest)#023.speaker: Tirt

Zhight Island (Quest)#024.src: My father started following him with a small sailboat he made, and decided on the perfect place to attack.
Zhight Island (Quest)#024.dst: Babam yaptığı küçük bir yelkenliyle onu takip etmeye başladı ve saldırmak için en uygun yeri seçti.
Zhight Island (Quest)#024.speaker: Tirt

Zhight Island (Quest)#025.src: But then Phief just had to throw a hissy fit and leave us stranded here.
Zhight Island (Quest)#025.dst: Ama Phief illa ki bir tantana koparıp bizi burada mahsur bırakacaktı.
Zhight Island (Quest)#025.speaker: Tirt

Zhight Island (Quest)#026.src: My father took a paddleboat back to {p} to gather supplies. He took the cargo the ship had with him.
Zhight Island (Quest)#026.dst: Babam malzeme toplamak için bir kürekli tekneyle {p} tarafına döndü. Gemideki yükü de yanında götürdü.
Zhight Island (Quest)#026.speaker: Tirt

Zhight Island (Quest)#027.src: If you need that, you should go talk to him. His name is Czytash.
Zhight Island (Quest)#027.dst: O sana lazımsa gidip onunla konuşmalısın. Adı Czytash.
Zhight Island (Quest)#027.speaker: Tirt

Zhight Island (Quest)#028.src: Get Zhight's supplies from Czytash at {p}

Zhight Island (Quest)#029.src: Ah, yes, I did find plenty o' supplies on that ship.
Zhight Island (Quest)#029.dst: Ah, evet, o gemide bi' sürü malzeme buldum.
Zhight Island (Quest)#029.speaker: Czytash

Zhight Island (Quest)#030.src: I assumed it was more of Phief's thiefed goods, so I took it home to use it myself.
Zhight Island (Quest)#030.dst: Phief'in çaldığı mallardan biri sandım, ben de kendim kullanmak için eve götürdüm.
Zhight Island (Quest)#030.speaker: Czytash

Zhight Island (Quest)#031.src: It is Zhight's supplies you say?
Zhight Island (Quest)#031.speaker: Czytash

Zhight Island (Quest)#032.src: Aye, of course it had to be that idiot's.
Zhight Island (Quest)#032.speaker: Czytash

Zhight Island (Quest)#033.src: I guess me thinking he's dumber'n a box o' rocks is no reason for me to let him starve... Here, take the crate.
Zhight Island (Quest)#033.dst: Herifin bir çuval taştan daha kalın kafalı olduğunu düşünmem, onu aç bırakmam için sebep değil herhalde... Al, sandığı götür.
Zhight Island (Quest)#033.speaker: Czytash

Zhight Island (Quest)#034.src: I haven't opened it yet, so everything is left exactly how he ordered it.
Zhight Island (Quest)#034.dst: Daha açmadım, yani her şey tam sipariş ettiği gibi duruyor.
Zhight Island (Quest)#034.speaker: Czytash

Zhight Island (Quest)#035.src: I wonder what is on that numbskull's menu, that crate smelled rancid. Almost threw it off me boat.
Zhight Island (Quest)#035.dst: O mankafanın menüsünde ne var merak ediyorum, sandık leş gibi kokuyordu. Az kalsın teknemden atıyordum.
Zhight Island (Quest)#035.speaker: Czytash

Zhight Island (Quest)#036.src: Anyways, good luck on your adventure matey.
Zhight Island (Quest)#036.speaker: Czytash

Zhight Island (Quest)#037.src: Sorry, what was that? My son?
Zhight Island (Quest)#037.speaker: Czytash

Zhight Island (Quest)#038.src: Ah, I figured it is about time he learned how to maneuver a boat. I fixed everything before I left.
Zhight Island (Quest)#038.dst: Ah, tekne kullanmayı öğrenmesinin vakti geldi diye düşündüm. Gitmeden önce her şeyi tamir ettim.
Zhight Island (Quest)#038.speaker: Czytash

Zhight Island (Quest)#039.src: When he returns, he will return a man.
Zhight Island (Quest)#039.speaker: Czytash

Zhight Island (Quest)#040.src: Wait, why am I telling you this? Butt out of my personal life, and just bring the man his crate.
Zhight Island (Quest)#040.dst: Dur, bunu sana niye anlatıyorum ki? Özel hayatıma burnunu sokma da adama sandığını götür.
Zhight Island (Quest)#040.speaker: Czytash

Zhight Island (Quest)#042.src: Ahaaa, esteemed sir! Or madame! I can't actually tell under all that armour...
Zhight Island (Quest)#042.dst: Ahaaa, saygıdeğer beyefendi! Ya da hanımefendi! O kadar zırhın altından anlayamıyorum da...
Zhight Island (Quest)#042.speaker: Zhight

Zhight Island (Quest)#043.src: ER! I MEAN! N-No trouble at all, esteemed visitor! We at {p} Resort are always welcoming!
Zhight Island (Quest)#043.dst: EE! YANİ! H-Hiç sorun değil, saygıdeğer misafirim! Biz {p} Tatil Köyü olarak herkese her zaman kapımızı açarız!
Zhight Island (Quest)#043.speaker: Zhight

Zhight Island (Quest)#044.src: ...wait, is that the... Oh my! The supply crate! You went out and found Phief?! What an upstanding fellow you are!
Zhight Island (Quest)#044.dst: ...dur, o şey... Aman! Malzeme sandığı! Gidip Phief'i buldun mu?! Ne kadar dürüst birisin!
Zhight Island (Quest)#044.speaker: Zhight

Zhight Island (Quest)#045.src: Wait, he was a boat thief? Well, good thing you've told me, we can't have pirates here at our resort! I'll blacklist him ASAP!
Zhight Island (Quest)#045.dst: Dur, gemi hırsızı mıydı? Neyse ki söyledin, tatil köyümüzde korsan istemeyiz! Onu derhal kara listeye alacağım!
Zhight Island (Quest)#045.speaker: Zhight

Zhight Island (Quest)#046.src: You're only a visitor but you've been more help today than anyone else, really, I'm honestly in your debt.
Zhight Island (Quest)#046.dst: Sadece bir misafirsin ama bugün herkesten çok yardım ettin, cidden, gerçekten sana borçluyum.
Zhight Island (Quest)#046.speaker: Zhight

Zhight Island (Quest)#047.src: So here! The repairs at the Zhight Grand Exchange and Zhight Treasure Tour have just finished, so you can head in and see the fruits of your labor!
Zhight Island (Quest)#047.dst: Al bakalım! Zhight Grand Exchange ve Zhight Treasure Tour'daki tamirat az önce bitti, içeri girip emeğinin meyvelerini görebilirsin!
Zhight Island (Quest)#047.speaker: Zhight

Zhight Island (Quest)#048.src: And, as a token of my thanks, some exclusive currency for our resort, Zhight Money, on the house and just for you! I hope you enjoy your stay!
Zhight Island (Quest)#048.dst: Ve teşekkürümün bir nişanesi olarak, tatil köyümüze özel para, Zhight Money, müesseseden ve sadece senin için! Umarım konaklamanın keyfini çıkarırsın!
Zhight Island (Quest)#048.speaker: Zhight

Zhight Island (Quest)#049.src: Terribly sorry but the Zhight Grand Exchange is under repairs right now! You can't go in yet!
Zhight Island (Quest)#049.dst: Çok üzgünüm ama Zhight Grand Exchange şu an tamirde! Henüz içeri giremezsin!

Zhight Island (Quest)#050.src: Maybe you can help me with that. The ship should still be stuck, due north of here, it has a red and white sail. I'd love to get my sea legs back.
Zhight Island (Quest)#050.dst: Belki bu konuda bana yardım edebilirsin. Gemi hâlâ buranın tam kuzeyinde takılı kalmış olmalı, kırmızı beyaz bir yelkeni var. Yeniden denizlere açılmayı çok isterim.
Zhight Island (Quest)#050.speaker: Phief

similar.text: Maybe you can help me with that. The ship should still be stuck, due north of here. I'd love to get my sea legs back.
Welcome traveler, to our humble island...

Zhight Island (Quest)#052.src: Oh? Well, greetings. What brings you all the way up here?
Zhight Island (Quest)#052.dst: Hm? Şey, selamlar. Seni buralara kadar ne getirdi?

Zhight Island (Quest)#053.src: Hello and welcome! Are you here to try the Zhight Treasure Tour? I'll teach you the rules!
Zhight Island (Quest)#053.dst: Merhaba ve hoş geldin! Zhight Treasure Tour'u denemeye mi geldin? Sana kuralları anlatayım!
Zhight Island (Quest)#053.speaker:
Zhight Tour Guide
󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿬󐀂

Zhight Island (Quest)#054.src: Simply pay for a token down in the cave and deposit it at the collector, and you'll be ushered into a sprawling cave system!
Zhight Island (Quest)#054.dst: Aşağıdaki mağarada bir jeton satın al ve toplayıcıya at, seni koca bir mağara sistemine götürecekler!
Zhight Island (Quest)#054.speaker: Sakaki_nagi's Bird

Zhight Island (Quest)#055.src: It's full of dangerous enemies and perilous plights, but they carry lots of rewards and riches!
Zhight Island (Quest)#055.dst: İçi tehlikeli düşmanlar ve zorlu belalarla dolu, ama bol bol ödül ve hazine de var!
Zhight Island (Quest)#055.speaker: Sakaki_nagi's Bird

Zhight Island (Quest)#056.src: If you stay in the cave for five minutes, or if you want to leave early or get knocked out, you'll be brought out of the cave.
Zhight Island (Quest)#056.dst: Mağarada beş dakika kalırsan, erken çıkmak istersen ya da bayılırsan mağaradan dışarı çıkarılırsın.

Zhight Island (Quest)#057.src: Anything you find in there, and we do mean ANYTHING, is yours to keep.
Zhight Island (Quest)#057.dst: İçeride bulduğun her şey, ama HER ŞEY, senin olur.
Zhight Island (Quest)#057.speaker: Sakaki_nagi's Bird

Zhight Island (Quest)#058.src: You can also exchange some of our special tokens for things that adventuring types like yourself will find indispensable, up in the gazebo!
Zhight Island (Quest)#058.dst: Ayrıca yukarıdaki çardakta özel jetonlarımızdan bazılarını senin gibi maceracıların vazgeçemeyeceği şeylerle değiştirebilirsin!
Zhight Island (Quest)#058.speaker: Sakaki_nagi's Bird

Zhight Island (Quest)#059.src: We hope you enjoy your stay at {p} Resort, thank you!
Zhight Island (Quest)#059.dst: {p} Tatil Köyü'nde keyifli vakit geçirmeni dileriz, teşekkürler!
